assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated Sega 32X cartridge animation layer. Image 1 is the approved console: exact camera, colors, light and chunky pixel style. Image 2 is a real 32X game cartridge: use ONLY its physical shell shape, never its pixels or game label art. Create one original pixel-art cartridge. Match the real shell: black wide rectangular case about 1.55 times wider than tall, gently rounded top corners, broad recessed rectangular label with rounded lower corners, smooth vertical grip panels at both sides, a subtly curved horizontal molded line under the label, and six short vertical indentations along the lower face. There are NO horizontal fins across the top, and NO 32X adaptor oval badge. The front label is an original simple orange field with a narrow gold stripe at its left reading 32X in black. No Doom artwork or game title. Connector edge points downward. Face the cartridge almost straight toward camera, with horizontal across edges, a narrow top edge visible and a thin right face, aligned with image 1's top slot. Draw ONLY the complete cartridge centered on a truly transparent square canvas, filling 70 percent of width. Crisp square pixel clusters, dark blue-grey outlines, lavender-grey shadows, cream upper-left edges. No console, cables, controller, hands, external shadows, floor or decoration. Redraw from scratch; do not reduce or pixelate the photo.
